hook.name: BotcoinWethFeeHook
hook.description: A single-pool BOTCOIN/WETH hook that charges configurable input fees on every swap, routing fee revenue to a protocol vault for rewards, burns, and subsidies. NFT holders receive a discount, and a TWAP-gated botcoin conversion buffer fills buy-side swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Also lazily executes subsidy conversions and bonus campaigns during swap callbacks.
